tr: Eğer onlar bize yardım etmezlerse, her şeyi vaktinde bitiremeyeceğiz.
en: Unless they help us, we won't be able to finish everything on time.

tr: Eğer unutmazsam, bu akşam annemi arayacağım.
en: Unless I forget, I will call my mother tonight.
Unless you hurry, you will miss your bus.

tr: Eğer Ali özür dilemeseydi, bir daha onunla konuşmazdım.
en: Unless Ali apologised, I wouldn't talk to him again.

tr: Eğer daha çok çalışmasaydım, sınavı geçemezdim.
en: Unless I studied harder, I couldn't pass the exam.
Unless you rest, you might get sick.
Unless you rested, you could be sick.
Unless you hurry, you will miss the bus.

tr: Eğer tüm gece çalışmazsan, işleri bitiremezsin.
en: Unless you work all night, you can't finish the work.
Unless it rains, we will go on a picnic.
Unless it was important, I wouldn't call you.
Unless he studies, he will fail the exam.

tr: Sen bizi davet etmeseydin, burada olmazdık.
en: Unless you invited us, we wouldn't be here.

tr: Eğer yolu tamir etmezlerse, daha fazla kaza olacak.
en: Unless they repair the road, there will be more accidents.
Unless we leave now, we will miss the movie.
Unless the teacher explains again, I won't understand.
Unless you tell the truth, nobody believes you.
Unless it was safe, I wouldn't get on the plane.
Unless you try, you never know.
Unless you try, you will never know.
Unless it's urgent, don't call me.

tr: Şimdi harekete geçmezsek, çok geç olacak.
en: Unless we take action now, it will be too late.
Unless you apologise, I won't forgive you.
Unless you make a payment now, we won't send your order.
Unless it was necessary, we wouldn't cancel the trip.
Unless it snows, we will go out.
Unless he comes soon, we will start without him.
Unless it gets colder, we won't build a fire.
Unless you lock the door, someone can come in.
Unless I saw it myself, I wouldn't believe it.
Unless he leaves soon, he will miss his plane.
Unless we work together, we won't be able to finish the work on time.
Unless you talk to me, I can't recognize you.
Unless it snows, they will open the schools.
Unless you write it, you will forget.
Unless we eat the food now, it will get cold.

tr: Bir nedenim olmadıkça, o yeri ziyaret etmezdim.
en: Unless I had a reason, I wouldn't visit that place.
